title: 15亿消费者市场：卡尼称资本配置不足，向基准靠拢会带来多少流入？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Prime Minister Karni, thank you for taking the time to sit down with us. Thanks for doing this, Brian.
segments.zh: 卡尼总理，感谢您抽时间与我们坐下来交谈。谢谢，布莱恩。

segments.en: So we're in Toronto for the first ever Canada Investment Summit.
segments.zh: 我们正在多伦多参加首届加拿大**峰会。

segments.en: You've got many of the biggest names in the world in terms of money management here, sovereign wealth funds, investment firms, asset managers.
segments.zh: 您邀请了全球资管领域的众多顶级机构，主权财富基金、**公司、资管机构。

segments.en: And you've got a deal book for them to look through. Canadian infrastructure, mines, oil, gas, clean technology, data centers.
segments.zh: 您还准备了一份项目清单供他们审阅。加拿大基础设施、矿业、石油、天然气、清洁技术、数据中心。

segments.en: I'm told you we're quite involved in the planning of this.
segments.zh: 我听说您深度参与了此次峰会的筹划。

segments.en: Give us your pitch. Why was this a big priority for you? Well, look, I think Canada is one of the most connected economies in the world.
segments.zh: 请谈谈您的推介。为什么这对您是个重要优先事项？我认为加拿大是全球联系最紧密的经济体之一。

segments.en: We have trade deals covering one and a half billion consumers.
segments.zh: 我们的贸易协定覆盖15亿消费者。

segments.en: Our pension funds, our financial institutions are very involved in investing in other countries.
segments.zh: 我们的养老金基金和金融机构深度参与对其他国家的**。

segments.en: We want reciprocity. You want to welcome foreign capital here in a bigger scale, bringing energy, ideas, capital
segments.zh: 我们希望互惠。你们希望更大规模地欢迎外国资本，带来能源、理念和资本。

segments.en: yes. We do have capital here, but there's different perspectives.
segments.zh: 是的。我们这里确实有资本，但存在不同视角。

segments.en: We also have been making some big changes over the course of the last year and a half.
segments.zh: 过去一年半我们也做了不少重大调整。

segments.en: Now's the time to look at Canada fresh. And one of the things that we've discovered over the course of the last year is that foreign capital is under allocated to Canada.
segments.zh: 现在是重新审视加拿大市场的好时机。过去一年我们发现，海外资本对加拿大的配置明显不足。

segments.en: It's not, I mean, we're on Bloomberg, so I can say that it's not market weight to Canada.
segments.zh: 在彭博台上我可以直说，加拿大市场并未达到市场基准权重。

segments.en: So even a shift to market weight to Canada will create a tremendous inflow of capital.
segments.zh: 因此，哪怕只是向市场基准权重靠拢，也会带来大量资金流入。

segments.en: And it's going to help us realize what we think this economy needs, which is to catalyze about a trillion dollars of investment over the next five years.
segments.zh: 这将帮助我们实现经济所需，也就是在未来五年催化约一万亿美元的资本投入。

segments.en: So why is Canada underweight? What's your diagnosis?
segments.zh: 那么加拿大为何被低配？您怎么诊断？
